freeze: Final case/rubric candidate frozen before #42; changes require revision-log entry and affected evidence revalidation.
reserved_policy: Evaluator inspection and legality validation allowed. No playing attempt or targeted prompt tuning before first #42 acceptance. After targeted repair, call it regression evidence.

cases.hard_gate: Only verified basic facts, legal physical routes, visibility and material consistency; unresolved strategic alternatives are uncertain. Winner counts below refer only to the initial case state; later decisions use actual remaining cards and won tricks. Concise answers need not repeat a winner count every turn.
cases.title: Normal plan continuation
properties: Use only the same live run previous plan and actual executed events.
Retain a still-applicable concrete route, or explain a justified replacement.
acceptable_alternatives: Keep or replace when consistent with actual state.
Different lawful spot cards or feasible club routes.
severe_errors: Invent prior execution or revive consumed cards.
Contradict actual current card or active plan.
cases.coverage_trigger: At least three model decisions with an actual previous plan and no newly disproved premise; otherwise uncovered.

cases.title: New public information
properties: Two club rounds with both defenders following prove 3-2 already.
The defender showing a third club localizes the length before the other defender discards.
Assess keep or replace against actual newly visible information.
acceptable_alternatives: Justified retention when original plan anticipated the break.
Revised route conditional on actual observed cards.
severe_errors: Require both defenders to follow three club rounds with five missing clubs.
Invent the other defender specific discard before it occurs.
cases.coverage_trigger: Both defenders actually follow two club rounds during this live run; otherwise uncovered.

cases.title: Entries and consumed cards
properties: Track which top clubs and heart entries remain at each actual decision.
Explain physically available transport for any remaining established clubs.
acceptable_alternatives: Either reviewed club route and any other concretely feasible entry route.

severe_errors: Reuse a played card or name a nonexistent necessary entry.
Cash winners in the opposite hand without a route to that hand.
